goal: Show how a short kinetic typography statement is planned, built and reviewed from one contract
audience: Studio users learning code-based motion graphics
message: Clear motion starts with one idea
concept: Each scene reveals one part of the statement: the idea, the three steps that realize it, and a calm resolved ending

runtime.value: Remotion kinetic type starter or GSAP motion starter; single-file preview where no renderer exists

viewing: 16:9 on a laptop or larger screen

confirmed: Exact illustrative copy in the copy ledger
proposed: Arial as an illustrative system font
unknown: Final brand font and colours for a real project

acceptance: The title is fully readable from frame 24 until its exit begins
The connector grows at constant speed and reaches the last step before its hold
The final card is stable and unchanged from frame 230 to frame 299

scenes.purpose: State the idea with a line mask reveal
scenes.focalPoint: First headline line, left aligned on the margin
scenes.entry: Lines rise from their masks, 6 frames apart
scenes.exit: Fade and lift over the last 10 frames
scenes.transition: Overlaps the steps entry for 10 frames
acceptance: Both lines readable for at least 92 frames

scenes.purpose: Three steps enter with a word stagger and a constant-speed connector
scenes.focalPoint: The step that is currently entering, then the whole row
scenes.entry: Items rise and fade in, 8 frames apart
scenes.action: Connector grows linearly behind the items
scenes.exit: Fade and lift over the last 10 frames
scenes.transition: Overlaps the end card for 10 frames
scenes.persistence: Accent colour continues into the end card rule
acceptance: All three steps readable together for at least 55 frames

scenes.purpose: End card with the longest readable hold and a stable final frame
scenes.entry: Fade and settle from 94% scale with ease-out expo
scenes.action: Accent rule grows under the statement
acceptance: Frame 299 equals the settled end state
